answer: Each epoch the economy broadcasts a random pulse to every registered agent. To continue the voyage, an agent must reply with a signed proof - a short sonnet of attestations bound to its unique hardware key and locked stake. Because that pulse is unpredictable and each identity needs its own key, an attacker running a thousand fakes must answer a thousand challenges with a thousand distinct keys while every bond stays locked; any reused key or copied sonnet is flagged as a clone and slashed. The bill therefore grows linearly with each Sybil while rewards are split among them.
